claims.text: Safe concurrent WRITE dispatch: PHASE 1 only (gating, not landing).
claims.why: The code calls gate_candidates which presumably gates; no landing is done in this chunk.

claims.text: Every write task in ``tasks`` runs CONCURRENTLY, each through :class:`daedalus.spine.attempt.TaskAttempt` in its own worktree (``offload()`` as the runner).
claims.why: The chunk calls gate_candidates but does not show its implementation; the claim about TaskAttempt and offload() is not verifiable here.

claims.text: Returns one :class:`daedalus.kairos.gated_writes.GatedCandidate` per accepted write task.
claims.why: The return of gate_candidates is not shown; the type of elements cannot be confirmed.

claims.text: The primary checkout at ``repo_root`` is NEVER touched by this call -- that is ``TaskAttempt``'s own structural guarantee (see ``tests/test_spine_attempt.py::test_happy_path_artifact_and_primary_untouched``).
claims.why: No code in chunk touches repo_root; the guarantee is external.

claims.text: Advisory-only tasks are bounced (this method only accepts write-mode work; use :meth:`plan`/:meth:`accept` for the routing verdict on the rest of a mixed task list, or :meth:`dispatch` to actually run them).
claims.why: The code filters writes with `a.accepted and a.mode == 'write'`, but the bouncing behavior for advisory tasks is not shown in this chunk.

claims.text: ``cancel``, when given, is forwarded unchanged to :func:`daedalus.kairos.gated_writes.gate_candidates`.
claims.why: Line 296 shows `cancel=cancel` in the call to gate_candidates.

claims.text: Landing a candidate this returns into ``repo_root`` is a SEPARATE, explicit act -- see :func:`daedalus.kairos.gated_writes.promote_candidates` and the comment on ``can_parallel`` in :meth:`dispatch` for why this method does not do that itself.
claims.why: No landing code is present in this chunk; the claim refers to external functions.

claims.text: One-shot entry: decompose a single objective into subtasks, then plan (dry_run) or dispatch (live) them across the bounded local bench.
claims.why: Code shows decompose, then if dry_run plan else dispatch.

claims.text: This is the dynamic counterpart to the hardcoded ``_demo_tasks`` flow -- the subtasks come from :func:`daedalus.kairos.decompose.decompose` (local model with a deterministic per-path fallback), not a fixed list.
claims.why: The decompose function is imported but its behavior is not shown.

claims.text: Dynamic agent configurator: mint or reshape an agent-role definition at runtime. Ikarus owns the crew roster, so creating/editing roles is his job -- routing (``router.load_agents``) picks up the change with no restart.
claims.why: The chunk imports agents_registry but does not show router.load_agents.

claims.text: Returns a summary; raises ValueError on an invalid spec.
claims.why: The code does not show a raise; the return is a dict but no error handling shown.

observations.what: Concurrent dispatch uses ThreadPoolExecutor with max_workers from self.max_workers.
gate_concurrent_writes filters accepted tasks with mode 'write' and delegates to gate_candidates.
spawn imports decompose and calls plan or dispatch.
configure uses agents_registry to create or update roles.
main parses --max-workers and --json, creates KairosScheduler, runs demo plan, and outputs JSON or table.
